sentences.en: My dad works at a store.
He goes to the store at seven in the morning.
At noon he does not go home; he eats at the store.
At six in the evening, he goes home.
Dad is very busy, and he likes his job a lot.
I also want to go take a look at his store.

quiz.q: What time does Dad go to the store in the morning?
Where does Dad eat at noon?

grammar.p: 在 + place + verb — where an action happens
grammar.e: In Chinese the place phrase comes before the verb: 在商店工作 (at-store work), the opposite order from English 'work at the store'.
grammar.x: 我爸爸在商店工作。 — My dad works at a store.

grammar.e: Time words like 早上七点 come before the verb, and usually right after the subject.
grammar.x: 他早上七点去商店。 — He goes to the store at seven in the morning.

grammar.e: Put 不 before the verb to say 'not'. Before a fourth-tone syllable it is read bú, elsewhere bù.
grammar.x: 中午他不回家。 — At noon he does not go home.
